Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist
We're partnering with an established fintech that's using data science to solve complex business problems at scale. Operating in a highly digital environment, data sits at the centre of decision-making, giving the team the opportunity to test ideas quickly, measure outcomes, and create meaningful impact across the business.
As the company continues to invest in its Data & ML capabilities, they're looking for a Data Scientist to join a collaborative team where curiosity, analytical thinking and commercial impact are valued just as highly as technical expertise.
About the role:This is an opportunity to apply statistics, machine learning and advanced analytics to solve real business problems. You'll work closely with commercial teams to understand complex challenges, identify opportunities, and develop data-driven solutions that create measurable value.
The role has a particular focus on marketing and growth, but you'll be joining a wider Data Science function and working alongside experienced Data Scientists on a variety of business-critical initiatives.
This is a role for someone who enjoys asking the right questions, applying the appropriate analytical techniques, and taking ownership of problems from initial exploration through to models being deployed into production and delivering measurable impact.
What you'll do:Frame business challenges as data science problems and identify the most appropriate analytical approach.Develop statistical and machine learning models that improve decision making and business performance.Design and evaluate experiments, causal analyses and predictive models to generate actionable insights.Work closely with business stakeholders to understand priorities and translate data into commercial value.Partner with engineering teams to ensure models are successfully deployed, monitored and continue delivering value in production.Identify new opportunities where data science can improve efficiency and support business growth.
About you:We're looking for someone with a strong academic foundation who enjoys applying theory to real-world business challenges.
You'll likely have:3+ years' experience in a Data Science or advanced analytics role.A degree in Mathematics, Statistics or another highly quantitative discipline, with a Master's degree or above preferred.Strong Python skills for data analysis, statistical modelling and machine learning.Excellent understanding of statistical methods, modelling techniques and when to apply them appropriately.Experience building models that have been deployed into production and created measurable business value.Confidence translating ambiguous business questions into structured analytical solutions.Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.A proactive mindset and the ability to take ownership from problem definition through to business impact.
Experience working with marketing analytics, experimentation, attribution or customer behaviour would be beneficial, but the strongest candidates will be those with excellent data science fundamentals and a passion for solving business problems.
Why join?This is a business where data genuinely drives decisions. With a highly digital product and rich datasets, you'll be able to form hypotheses, test them quickly and see the impact of your work in real time.
You'll be joining a collaborative Data & ML team within an established fintech that combines the stability of a successful business with the agility and autonomy of a smaller organisation. Rather than working on isolated research projects or predefined tickets, you'll have the opportunity to shape solutions, influence decision-making and see your work translate into measurable commercial outcomes.
The company offers a flexible hybrid working model (typically two to three days a week in their central Stockholm office), modern tooling, excellent benefits and the opportunity to work alongside experienced Data Scientists in an environment that values continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.
If you're a Data Scientist who enjoys combining strong statistical thinking with practical problem solving - and wants to see your work make a tangible business impact - we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
At Lendo, we’re driven by a clear mission: to empower people to make smarter financial decisions. Our work directly impacts how users understand and navigate complex financial journeys, and we take that responsibility seriously.

We build our success on a culture where we live by our core values: customer centric, win as a team, focus on execution, and always improve. We are convinced that it is diverse perspectives, differences, and a strong collective drive that allow us to continue evolving. We are always looking for colleagues who wants to grow together with us.

About The Role

We are looking for a Data Scientist to drive business impact through machine learning. We have already created significant value from ML across several areas and see strong opportunities to apply it even more broadly, including marketing, conversion optimization, and operational decision-making. We are looking for a Data Scientist who has successfully created business impact with ML and is energized by delivering measurable results.

What You Will Do


Build, deploy, and improve machine learning models that drive measurable impact across domains such as marketing, conversion optimization, and operational efficiency.
Design, analyze, and interpret experiments, causal analyses, and marketing mix models (MMM) to guide marketing investments.
Be a trusted advisor within ML and partner with product, business, and engineering teams to translate problems into ML solutions.
Ensure models deliver continuous business value.


About You


3+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, with a track record of shopping models that created measurable business value.
Strong modeling expertise with solid foundations in statistics and machine learning, and a clear understanding of when and how to apply different methods
Experience designing and interpreting experiments and casual analyses
Ability to work effectively with non-technical stakeholders..
Ability to take initiative and drive ML opportunities end-to-end, from problem framing to deployment and measurable business impact.
Strong Python programming skills and comfort working in production environments.


We believe great people do their best work when they’re trusted. That’s why we offer high autonomy, real ownership and clear accountability. You’ll help create measurable business impact through machine learning in a core growth area, while collaborating with a strong, supportive Data & ML team that values well-being, technical excellence and continuous improvement. You’ll work with a modern tech stack, including production ML systems and generative AI tools, supported by competitive compensation and a flexible hybrid setup.

About The Recruitment Process

As part of our recruitment process, we use psychometric testing through HI Assessments. We also perform a mandatory background check on all final candidates. We will always inform you as a candidate before the check is carried out.

We look forward to your application!

Title: Data Science / AI Engineer
Description:
Description

Why NESS

We know that people are our greatest asset. Our staff's professionalism, innovation, teamwork, and dedication to excellence have helped us become one of the world's leading technological companies. It is these qualities that are vital to our continued success. As a Ness employee, you will be working on products and platforms for some of the most innovative software companies in the world.

You'll gain knowledge by working alongside other highly skilled professionals that will help accelerate your career progression.

You'll also benefit from a range of advantages, including access to training and certifications, bonuses, aids, social activities, and attractive compensation.

Salary: from 2.500-3.000 EUR/month depending on seniority, skills and experience + benefits. The final offer for the selected candidate will reflect the candidate´s comprehensive assessment, skills, and past work experience.

Requirements and responsibilities:

We are seeking a Data Scientist with an interest in Generative AI, LLMs, Machine Learning, and agentic systems. This role is part of a newly established Advanced Solutions team focused on applied AI research, rapid prototyping, and turning innovative ideas into real business solutions.

Working in a dynamic, startup-like environment, you'll receive high-level challenges and collaborate with the team to quickly design, build, test, and iterate on AI solutions. We're looking for someone who enjoys experimenting, learning new technologies, and taking ownership from idea to implementation.

What you'll do:


Reinvent how insights are shared and consumed by our customers.
High-level orchestration across data ecosystems to eliminate silos.
Hyper-personalization and natural interaction for fleet operations.
Seamless "what if" scenario exploration and data-driven decision making for fleet managers.
Design and build AI components that enhance predictive models for accident risk, energy consumption, tire wear, and other key indicators.
Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on new AI, Machine Learning, and GenAI solutions.
Work across the full lifecycle—from understanding the problem, preparing data, building prototypes, validating results, and deploying working solutions.
Contribute to long-term innovation by exploring emerging AI technologies, bringing new ideas, and experimenting with modern frameworks and approaches.
Collaborate closely with a small international team to solve open-ended business challenges and deliver practical AI solutions.
Experiment with technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, Agentic AI, and other modern AI frameworks where appropriate.
Evaluate different approaches and select solutions based on business value, performance, and scalability.
Contribute across the full lifecycle—from prototype (POC) to industrialization and market launch.
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to work independently and take ownership.
Excellent communication skills for collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Curiosity, adaptability, and enthusiasm for learning new technologies in a fast-paced environment.


Key skillsets:


Data Scientist / AI Engineer / Machine Learning Engineer
Around 2–5 years of experience in AI, Machine Learning, or Data Science (seniority is flexible—we're more interested in mindset, hands-on experience, and motivation).
Experience with Python and data processing (PySpark and SQL are an advantage).
Hands-on experience with Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, or Agentic AI through commercial or personal projects.
Understanding of modern AI technologies and willingness to continuously learn and experiment.
Ability to take ownership of tasks and deliver end-to-end solutions.
Detail-oriented with a practical, "getting things done" mindset.
Comfortable working in a fast-moving, startup-like environment with evolving priorities.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
English level: B2 minimum.


Not checking every single requirement?

If this role sounds good to you, even if you don't meet every single bullet point in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. For most of the candidates who applied, we found a role that was a very good fit with their skills.

Let's meet, and you may just be the right candidate for one of our roles.

At Ness Digital Engineering, we are willing to build a work culture that is based on diversification, inclusion, and authenticity.

Title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
Description:
Testo, with its headquarters in the Black Forest/Germany, is a world market leader in the field of portable and stationary measurement technology. Worldwide, roughly 3900 employees research, develop, produce and market innovative measurement solutions for Testo. The basis for this success, in addition to the highly qualified and motivated staff, is the above-average commitment to a future-oriented development - roughly 10% of the annual concern turnover is invested in Research & Development. With 37 subsidiary companies and over 80 distribution partners, Testo is represented on all five continents.

Role Description

As part of our commitment to leveraging data and AI to drive business value, we are seeking a curious and motivated Data Scientist to join our team.

In this key role, you will transform data into actionable insights, develop machine learning models, and help build the foundation for AI-driven decision-making across the organization. You will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to solve complex challenges and support Testo's data transformation journey.

Data Science & Modelling


Collect, explore, and analyze data from various business domains to uncover meaningful patterns and trends.
Build, validate, and iterate on statistical and machine learning models that address real business questions.
Apply techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, and time-series forecasting to a variety of use cases.
Translate model outputs into clear, actionable insights, making the complex understandable.


Business Collaboration & Insight Delivery


Work closely with teams across finance, operations, sales, and supply chain to understand their data needs and business context.
Act as a translator between data and business: listen to the business problem, find the right analytical approach, and present findings that stakeholders can act on.
Build dashboards and reports that make insights accessible and self-serviceable for non-technical users.


AI Enablement


Contribute to making our data platform AI-ready — helping to ensure that data is clean, structured, and accessible for AI tools and agents.
Support the development of interfaces (API or MCP server) that allow AI assistants and LLM-based tools to access business data reliably.
Explore and prototype AI/GenAI use cases together with the business and IT teams.


Continuous Learning & Data Culture


Stay up to date with developments in data science, machine learning, and AI - and bring new ideas into the team.
Help establish best practices for data usage and analytics across the organization.
Actively contributes to a culture where data is trusted, understood, and used to make better decisions.


What We Offer


A meaningful and impact-driven role at the heart of Testo's data transformation journey.
The opportunity to work with modern analytics and AI technologies in an international environment.
A collaborative, learning-oriented culture with room for professional development.
Flexible working arrangements and a supportive team atmosphere.
Competitive remuneration and a comprehensive benefits package.


Your Profile

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Informatics, or a related field.

Must-Have Experience


2-5 years of professional experience in Data Science or a related analytical field.
Strong hands-on experience with machine learning and statistical modelling.
Proven experience collecting, cleaning, exploring, and analyzing complex business datasets.
Experience presenting analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders and translating data into business value.


Nice-to-Have Experience


Experience with cloud data platforms or modern data stacks
Exposure to AI/GenAI use cases or LLM-based applications in a business context.
Experience in an SAP environment (SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, or similar) can be learned on the job.


Languages: Very good command of written and spoken English.

Personal Attributes


Genuinely curious about data and passionate about finding the story behind the numbers.
A fast learner who picks up new tools, technologies, and domains quickly — and enjoys doing so.
Strong communicator who can explain complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Business-minded: able to understand the "why" behind a question, not just the "how" of solving it.
Collaborative and open, thriving in cross-functional teams and an international environment.
Proactive and self-driven — comfortable working with ambiguity and taking initiative.

We are looking forward to receiving your application via Online-Portal.

The Data Scientist – Predictive Analytics applies advanced analytics, data science, and machine learning techniques to generate actionable insights and support strategic decision-making across the organization. This role partners closely with business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve complex challenges, and drive data-informed decisions. By translating data into meaningful business value, the Data Scientist contributes to dormakaba’s vision of becoming a truly analytics-driven organization.

What You Will Do

Predictive Modeling and Advanced Analytics Development


Design, develop, and validate statistical and machine learning models (e.g., forecasting, classification, optimization) to support strategic and operational decision-making.


Operationalization and Deployment of Analytics Solutions


Build and deploy predictive models and analytics pipelines into production environments using cloud-based and enterprise platforms.


MLOps, Monitoring, and Model Lifecycle Management


Implement and manage model lifecycle practices, including versioning, monitoring, retraining, performance tracking, and continuous improvement.


Cross-Functional Collaboration And Requirements Translation


Partner with stakeholders across Business Intelligence, Finance, Operations, Commercial, and IT functions to translate business challenges into analytical and predictive solutions.


Data Governance, Documentation, and Compliance


Ensure analytical solutions comply with enterprise data governance, security, and documentation standards.


Continuous Improvement and Analytics Maturity Advancement


Identify opportunities to automate processes, improve model performance, and elevate predictive analytics capabilities across the organization.


Insight Communication and Decision Support


Collaborate with business partners across Operations, Commercial, Finance, and other functions to communicate analytical findings, forecasts, and recommendations through dashboards, visualizations, and compelling data storytelling tailored to non-technical audiences.

Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or another quantitative field.
2–5+ years of experience in data science, predictive analytics, machine learning, or a related analytical role.
Strong expertise in statistical forecasting and demand planning methodologies, including hierarchical forecasting models, intermittent demand forecasting, forecast bias and coverage metrics, and other advanced forecasting performance measures beyond MAPE.
Strong experience working with enterprise data sources, particularly SAP and Salesforce.
Hands-on experience with Python and cloud-based analytics platforms, including Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric. Experience with Databricks is a plus.
Solid understanding of machine learning model development, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts and insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Fluent English is required.

Title: Data Scientist (Sales & Marketing Focus)
Description:
Do you have the required Data Science skills to drive real impact at one of the most recognisable brands globally?

You'll contribute to Global Data Science projects to enable business stakeholders from various departments incl. (Sales, Marketing, HR) to make better data-driven decisions. The Data Scientist will work closely with other team members to build and run data products, apply statistical analyses to solve business problems that generate impact, and create convincing presentations to demonstrate said impact to the wider organisation.You'll also be responsible for innovation by introducing new data-driven business ideas, new statistical methods, new data products, or by supporting new business processes.

All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:

DELIVER PROJECTS PART OF EXISTING DATA SCIENCE SERVICE LINES

You will support the team by efficiently managing, running, and delivering Data Science projects with a key focus on our Sales, Marketing and HR stakeholders. This end-to-end approach includes everything from project scoping, execution, quality assurance, and delivery via convincing presentations.

SCALE EXISTING DATA SCIENCE INITIATIVES

You will work together closely with IT colleagues to find efficiencies allowing us to scale our initiatives to more people and more Red Bull markets.

DRIVE INNOVATION

Not focusing exclusively on existing service lines and initiatives, you'll actively think along and propose new ways of generating even more value for our stakeholders.

MANAGE EXTERNAL CONSULTANTS

You'll manage our external colleagues and guide them to deliver Data Science projects in an efficient manner, ensuring top notch quality.

STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

You'll build close relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Thanks to your collaborative attitude and ability to absorb constructive feedback, you'll maximise the likelihood of making each and every Data Science initiative a success for the company.

Support The Data Science Manager With Core Responsibilities

You'll work inside the Data Science Team and will support them with impact tracking, projects, pipeline planning, preparing materials for the planning cycles, internal trainings, onboarding new colleagues, internal and external outreach and more.

Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:


2+ Years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or similar role.
Programming: knowledge and practical experience with both Python and SQL. Snowflake is a plus.
FMCG Knowledge: prior experience working at an FMCG company in a data or analytics focused role a plus.
Data Literacy: ability to prepare datasets ensuring top quality such that essence of said data and the implications for the problem at hand can be grasped quickly.
Statistical Reasoning: applied understanding of Stats and Probability and know how to use these tools to reduce uncertainty in a business context (regression, visualisation).
Technical Literacy: applied understanding of modern computing allows the candidate to do things which go beyond the strict definition of Data Science (git, API calls, web crawling, …).
Data Tooling: experience with version control (e.g., Git), familiarity with data transformation tools (e.g., dbt) and exposure to lightweight application frameworks (e.g., Streamlit, Shiny) is a plus.
Presentation Skills: present coherent data stories at the appropriate level of abstraction given the audience.
Stakeholder Management: good at building mutually beneficial connections with functional stakeholders.
Pragmatic Critical Thinking: intuitively consider relevant costs/benefits in all decisions and act accordingly.
Outcome Driven: highly motivated to add value and to demonstrate that impact to the organisation.
Scientific Reasoning/Scoping: ability to define and formulate new questions, in addition to answering given ones.
Grit: proven capability to see things through to the end even if initial feedback is discouraging.


Due to legal reasons, we are obliged to disclose the minimum salary according to the collective agreement for this position, which is EUR 2,504 gross per month. However, our attractive compensation package is based on market-oriented salaries and is therefore significantly above the stated minimum salary.

As an employer, we value diversity and support people in developing their potential and strengths, realizing their ideas and seizing opportunities. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, skin colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation or origin.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Haemme Data Scientistia Elon Asiakasanalytiikkatiimiin, rooliin, jossa data, analytiikka, tekoäly ja Elon strategia kohtaavat. Asiakasanalytiikka on osa Elon Analytiikkayksikköä ja keskeisessä roolissa tukemassa vakuutusliiketoiminnan kasvun ja asiakasarvon tuottamista älykkäiden ratkaisujen avulla. Analytiikka on uuden strategiamme ytimessä, ja tässä roolissa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten dataa ja teknologiaa hyödynnetään liiketoiminnan kehittämisessä.




Tiimimme kehittää ja toteuttaa analytiikkaratkaisuja muun muassa asiakashankinnan ja -hoidon tueksi, asiakaskokemuksen parantamiseen, palveluiden kehittämiseen sekä päätöksenteon tueksi. Asiakasymmärrys ja suomalaisten yritysten ymmärtäminen ovat meille tärkeitä. Hyödynnämme dataa, koneoppimista ja tekoälyä sekä kehitämme dataympäristöä ja työvälineitä yhteistyössä ICT:n kanssa. Rakennamme analytiikkaratkaisuja Azure-, Fabric- ja Databricks-alustoilla hyödyntäen moderneja teknologioita. Meille on tärkeää jatkuva osaamisen kehittäminen, uusien teknologioiden hyödyntäminen sekä tiedon jakaminen. Työkielenämme on suomi.




Tehtäväsi

Tehtävässä analysoit dataa, teet ennusteita, kehität koneoppimismalleja ja tekoälyratkaisuja, visualisoit tuloksia sekä rakennat analytiikkasovelluksia. Title: Data Scientist
HTML:
Requisitos

  • Licenciatura, Mestrado ou Doutoramento em área quantitativa (Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística, Informática ou equivalente);
  • Experiência relevante (3+ anos) no desenvolvimento de sistemas de machine learning ou pipelines de dados em ambiente de produção;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de programação e ciência de computadores, com domínio de frameworks de machine learning;
  • Pensamento de sistema: capacidade de decompor um problema de negócio numa arquitetura de decisão, e não apenas num modelo isolado;
  • Experimentação e medição de impacto: testes A/B / experiências controladas, dimensionamento de amostra (baseline, MDE, α/β), teste de hipóteses, e domínio da distinção entre correlação e causalidade;
  • Amplitude técnica: para além da modelação preditiva, conforto com problemas de otimização (e.g., assignment/matching, programação linear/inteira) e com o raciocínio sobre trade-offs;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e colaboração com equipas técnicas e de negócio;
  • Curiosidade intelectual, pensamento crítico e orientação para o impacto;
  • Capacidade de adaptação e de gestão de prioridades em ambientes de rápida evolução.


Valorizado

  • Experiência cruzada entre investigação e indústria;
  • Inferência causal aplicada;
  • Computação distribuída;
  • Experiência em otimização combinatória / operations research em contexto real.

Title: Product / Commercial Data Scientist
Description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

At Super Technologies, data isn't a support function — it's at the heart of every major decision we make. As a Product / Commercial Data Scientist, you'll work at the intersection of product, commercial, and marketing strategy. Your analyses won't sit in slide decks; they'll directly inform how millions of customers engage with our products.

What the role involves

Be the Decision Engine


Run deep-dive analyses into customer behaviour, product usage, and commercial performance to uncover the causal drivers behind key trends, not just surface-level metrics


Shape Strategy with Data


Inform product roadmaps, commercial tactics, and marketing strategies by framing the right questions, running experiments (including A/B testing and causal inference), and delivering insights that drive key decisions


Automate Intelligence


Define Metrics and KPIs, build dashboards and develop re-useable frameworks that help teams across Super make smarter, faster, data-driven decisions


Partner Across the Business


Collaborate with Product Managers, Commercial leads, Engineers, Designers, and Marketers, bringing analytical rigour to day-to-day decisions


Tackle Ambiguity


Translate business questions into sharp analytical problems, bringing structure to fast-moving projects


What we are looking for


2–4 years of relevant experience in analytics and/or product data science roles, ideally in product or commercial domains, with a track record of turning analysis into clear recommendations
SQL fluency (Snowflake) as a non-negotiable foundation, with a solid grounding in statistical/experimental methods and comfort with storytelling with data various using tools (Tableau)
Proficient in using AI tools (Claude/Gemini) to accelerate analytics, coding, experimentation, and insight generation, with strong judgment to validate outputs and ensure accuracy.
Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent work experience


Skills & mindset


The ability to transform complex analyses into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, making data accessible and actionable for decision-making
Good commercial and product instincts: connecting data outputs to business outcomes, product design, and customer behaviour rather than treating analysis as an end in itself
A bias for impact: orienting work around driving measurable change rather than model perfection, with success measured by whether analyses move the needle
Comfortable framing and running well-defined analyses independently, whilst knowing when to bring a manager or senior data scientist in on more ambiguous or cross-functional questions


Why join us?


High impact: your datasets will be used daily by teams making product decisions, running experiments, and driving performance
Real scale, real problems: handle serious data volumes — millions of events per day, multiple sources, and zero fluff
Freedom to shape: influence our data architecture, tooling, and best practices — not just implementing, but building


What we offer


Medical / Health Insurance
Open Annual Leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Training & Learning Development
Competitive compensation & performance-based bonuses
Wellness perks & team social budget


Additional benefits vary by country and will be shared during the hiring process.

We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

Shaping the Future of Play

Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA).

At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance.

Title: Data Scientist – Time Series & Anomaly Detection (m/f/d)
Description:
Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace.




About the Role




Bring intelligence to our IoT data streams! Whether stopping energy waste in stores or predicting machine failures through Predictive Maintenance, you develop the algorithms that spot critical patterns hidden within noisy sensor signals. You will work closely with our engineering teams across Heilbronn, Bucharest, and Sofia to run your anomaly detection models directly on scalable streaming architectures.




Our Technological Vision




Building and operating our central AI Anomaly Detection Engine. We rely on clean software architectures (Clean Architecture), scalable cloud systems, and cutting-edge data streaming technologies such as Kafka, PySpark, and MQTT to process high-volume time-series data in real time. For us, code is not just a means to an end, but the most powerful tool to actively shape our core business.




The Impact You Will Create




Model Development: You design and build state-of-the-art Anomaly Detection models (unsupervised & supervised learning) and Time-Series Forecasting algorithms for large-scale IoT sensor data.
Feature Engineering: You extract meaningful features and signals from raw sensor metrics, telemetry, and monitoring logs.
Production Coding: You write clean, production-ready Python code and collaborate with engineering to deploy models into cloud environments and real-time streaming architectures.
Data Preprocessing: You develop robust strategies for cleaning and preprocessing high-volume streaming data before it enters the ML pipelines.
Model Observability: You monitor not only the systems but also your models, ensuring high prediction quality, stability, and drift detection under changing operational conditions.




Experience and Skills You Will Need




Professional Experience: At least 3 years of hands-on experience specializing in Anomaly Detection or Time-Series Forecasting.
Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) with Python, along with experience or strong interest in industrial Machine Learning applications.
Problem Solving: Ability to deep-dive into complex technical challenges and deliver pragmatic, scalable solutions.
Agile Mindset: Passion for working in cross-functional, agile teams across locations to generate real business value.




Our Offer




25 days annual leave + 1 day annual leave after 5 years in the company
Meal tickets

Bring intelligence to our IoT data streams! Building and operating our central AI Anomaly Detection Engine. You're a data scientist with broad analytical and ML experience as well as production LLM expertise. Build and deliver data science solutions across the stack — predictive models, ranking systems, demand forecasting, and LLM-powered features — depending on where the business need is greatest
Take ownership of business-critical ML systems end-to-end: from problem framing and model design through to deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance in production environments
Act as the team's domain expert on LLMs: advise on model selection, architecture decisions, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation
Design and implement RAG architectures and evaluation frameworks where language models are the right tool for the problem
Apply classical ML and statistical modelling to structured business problems — pricing signals, supplier matching, catalogue enrichment — with rigorous attention to measurement and validation
Translate ambiguous business problems into tractable ML problems with clear success criteria, working closely with Product and Commercial stakeholders
Collaborate with Engineers to ship models via reproducible MLOps workflows — experiment tracking, model serving, alerting, and production monitoring — with a high bar for reliability and observability
Communicate model choices, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders including Product and commercial leadership


What You'll Bring


3+ years working as a data scientist or applied ML engineer, with meaningful exposure across both classical ML and deep learning
A track record of owning ML systems in production — not just building models, but maintaining, monitoring, and iterating on them as live business-critical infrastructure
Demonstrable LLM expertise — hands-on experience building and evaluating LLM-powered systems in a production or near-production environment
Solid grounding in ML fundamentals: statistics, probability, supervised and unsupervised learning
Practical experience with transformer architectures and the major model families (GPT, Claude, Llama, Mistral), including RAG pipeline design and vector database usage
Strong Python and SQL, with experience using LangChain, XGBoost, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers (or similar frameworks), MLOps tooling (experiment tracking, model serving, monitoring), and experience of orchestration for ETL pipelines (Airflow)
Experience with cloud ML services on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including deploying and operating models in distributed environments
Able to communicate uncertainty and model limitations clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders


Perks & Benefits


Base salary: €60,000 – €75,000 (Amsterdam) / £72,000 – £90,000 (London) depending on experience
26 days of annual leave, plus 4 additional personal days
Company performance-based bonus
Attractive equity package
Pension contributions

Office-led culture with hybrid flexibility
Dog-friendly offices

Office socials and annual company-wide offsite

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Data Scientist

The Role

We Are Looking For Versatile Data Scientists To Join Us At a Pivotal Stage Of Growth. We Don’t Believe In a "one-size-fits-all" Data Profile. We Value Diverse Technical Lenses—whether You Are Someone Who


thrives on topics like causal inference, measurement expertise, experimental design, or builder of business logic with a rigorous mathematical backbone who scales data products,
zero-to-one specialist who loves the ambiguity of turning a raw idea into a revenue-generating system.


These are some example traits that we are looking for in candidates, beyond your typical data science tasks.

You will be part of a team that prizes "AI-First" thinking and building. We want people who love to debug a problem deeply once, if you have to debug it twice, it’s time to automate it. We strive for high standards but remain focused on business outcomes. Every model or dashboard must have a clear "so what?"

What You Might Work On

Depending on your seniority, experience or specialisation, your impact may involve some (but not all) of the following:


Designing ML models that power real-time recSys, ranking and pricing algorithms, optimising for engagement and conversion within our gaming ecosystem.
Building reward structures and user-incentive systems that balance user motivation with sustainable ROAS through uplift modelling and pricing optimisation.
Leading complex experimentation iterations in data driven verticals, product or user acquisition, including causal impact estimation or measurement strategies such as MMM and Multi-Touch Attribution.
Zero to one projects, taking a blank slate in a unexplored domain and turning it into a production-ready data product, from initial data structures to final deployment.
Partnering with engineering to refine and develop our stack and system architecture and establishing "gold standard" documentation.


What We’re Looking For


Strong experience building and deploying machine learning models in a product-driven environment, ideally in Gaming, AdTech, gambling or user-incentive systems.
Robust experience of data engineering workflows and modern data stack tools (e.g DBT, Airflow, K8s, Terraform).
Proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with cloud platforms (GCP preferred)
Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to drive clarity, create structure, and bring stakeholders on board.


We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Title: Data Scientist, Agent
Description:
TL;DR — You own how we measure and improve Lovable's AI agent. You build the eval systems and experiments that tell us whether a change makes the agent better or worse, and you turn agent telemetry into the fixes that raise success rates and cut errors.

At Lovable, data scientists are not isolated model-builders; they sit close to the product, experimenting continuously with how intelligence changes user behavior and product dynamics.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What We're Looking For


A data scientist who wants to make an AI agent measurably better, not just report on it. You own agent quality metrics and drive them up.
Experience or strong interest in LLM evaluation and observability: building evals, scoring outputs, tracing agent behavior, and catching regressions.
Strong SQL and Python, applied statistics, and experimentation. Comfortable designing A/B tests for agent changes where outcomes are noisy.
You build systems and agents that produce this insight continuously, rather than one-off analyses.
Instinct for what "good" looks like in agent behavior (success, error rates, task completion) and how to measure it when there is no clean answer key.
Entrepreneurial. Thrives in ambiguity, and works closely with the engineers building the agent.


What You'll Do


Define and own the metrics for agent quality: success, completion, error rates, and the behaviors that drive them.
Build the eval systems and experiment framework that decide whether an agent change ships, like an A/B-tested rollout that catches a change increasing errors before it reaches everyone.
Turn agent traces and telemetry into concrete fixes, working directly with the agent engineering team.
Build the tooling and agents that produce these evaluations continuously as the agent evolves.
Set the bar for how we judge agent behavior where there is no answer key to check against.


Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:


Languages: SQL and Python
LLM evaluation & observability: Braintrust, OTEL tracing, many LLM providers
Warehouse & events: BigQuery, PubSub
Analytics & product: Hex, Lovable Apps
Experimentation: A/B and growth testing
Cloud: GCP


And always on the lookout for what's next.

How We Hire


Fill in a short form and jump on an intro call with our recruiting team
A call with the hiring manager
A take-home case study
A Most Impressive Project session
Cross-functional interviews with the people you'd work with
A final conversation with leadership


About Your Application

Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally. If you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

TL;DR — You own how we measure and improve Lovable's AI agent. You build the eval systems and experiments that tell us whether a change makes the agent better or worse, and you turn agent telemetry into the fixes that raise success rates and cut errors.

At Lovable, data scientists are not isolated model-builders; they sit close to the product, experimenting continuously with how intelligence changes user behavior and product dynamics.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What We're Looking For

  • A data scientist who wants to make an AI agent measurably better, not just report on it. You own agent quality metrics and drive them up.
  • Experience or strong interest in LLM evaluation and observability: building evals, scoring outputs, tracing agent behavior, and catching regressions.
  • Strong SQL and Python, applied statistics, and experimentation. Comfortable designing A/B tests for agent changes where outcomes are noisy.
  • You build systems and agents that produce this insight continuously, rather than one-off analyses.
  • Instinct for what "good" looks like in agent behavior (success, error rates, task completion) and how to measure it when there is no clean answer key.
  • Entrepreneurial. Thrives in ambiguity, and works closely with the engineers building the agent.

What You'll Do

  • Define and own the metrics for agent quality: success, completion, error rates, and the behaviors that drive them.
  • Build the eval systems and experiment framework that decide whether an agent change ships, like an A/B-tested rollout that catches a change increasing errors before it reaches everyone.
  • Turn agent traces and telemetry into concrete fixes, working directly with the agent engineering team.
  • Build the tooling and agents that produce these evaluations continuously as the agent evolves.
  • Set the bar for how we judge agent behavior where there is no answer key to check against.

Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

  • Languages: SQL and Python
  • LLM evaluation & observability: Braintrust, OTEL tracing, many LLM providers
  • Warehouse & events: BigQuery, PubSub
  • Analytics & product: Hex, Lovable Apps
  • Experimentation: A/B and growth testing
  • Cloud: GCP

And always on the lookout for what's next.

How We Hire

  • Fill in a short form and jump on an intro call with our recruiting team
  • A call with the hiring manager
  • A take-home case study
  • A Most Impressive Project session
  • Cross-functional interviews with the people you'd work with
  • A final conversation with leadership

About Your Application

Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally. If you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Title: Data Scientist - Machine Learning
Description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.


Taking ownership and driving impact
Being open to change and feedback
Being passionate about our mission and our customers.


Your Mission

With Ten-thousands Of Active Items On Auction Every Day, Hundred-thousands Of Bids, Millions Of Users, And Billions Of Events, The Catawiki Platform Generates Vast Amounts Of Data. We Collect This Data Centrally, Using It To Generate Business Insights, As Well As Powering Machine Learning Models That Enhance Our User Experience, Optimize Our Workflows, And Keep Our Platform Safe. We Believe In Creating Flexible Models That Can Be Applied To a Variety Of Use Cases, And In Experimentation And Iteration To Hit The Ground Running And Continually Improve The Tools We Build. The Data Team, Which Covers The Full Data Spectrum Of Machine Learning, Analysis And Data Engineering, Has a Clear a Mission Within Catawiki

Why: We believe that by using data in a smart way, we can build the best Catawiki possible. We want to have impact and see opportunities everywhere.

How: We are builders, thinkers and talkers. We collaborate closely with every department to create value for our customers. We think big and hold ourselves to high standards, because our work really matters for the future of the company.

What: As a result we create business value by delivering scalable, robust models and actionable insights and predictions. We help the company to find opportunities and understand success, and we empower everyone to use data to be successful.

What You'll Do

As a Machine Learning Data Scientist in the Data Team at Catawiki you will focus on delivering scalable and impactful data products. You’ll work closely with our product and development teams while implementing your work. This includes:


Building production-ready models that apply machine learning and advanced data science techniques within our product offering by writing robust and scalable code.
Finding data science opportunities by exploring our extensive mobile and web data, and applying machine learning and advanced statistics to tackle these real-world business problems.
Being pragmatic when needed but also able to go deep into a problem, applying your expert knowledge of machine learning techniques
Working with cross-disciplinary teams involving product owners, developers, UX designers, and business analysts in identifying improvements and new use cases for ML
Deploy scalable models using Kubernetes on cloud infrastructure, producing real-time, asynchronous, and batch predictions


What You'll Bring


Are an all-around data scientist with 3+ years of experience who is as comfortable diving into the internals of a model implementation as discussing new opportunities for ML with product stakeholders
Understand and apply standard and widespread ML techniques in your area with little support.
Have a strong quantitative background (statistics, ML, sciences, etc.)
Are fluent in Python and capable with SQL
Have deployed ML models in production serving real time responses on a large scale
Are able to effectively communicate about your models to a non tech-savvy audience
Have demonstrable experience in building robust data products that created value for the company you worked for


The Following Are a Plus


Experience with one or more of the following: Google cloud platform, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD, Recommender systems, PyTorch, Kafka, nginx
Experience working on developing ML products for online marketplaces / ecommerce platforms
An entrepreneurial mindset that enables you to get things done, even if that requires actions outside your own area or comfort zone.
Proven ability to extract meaning from very big datasets with little engineering support.


Where You'll Be

This role is based in Lisbon. We work in a hybrid model with two days a week in the office.

Why You'll Love Working with Us


Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.


Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist
We're partnering with an established fintech that's using data science to solve complex business problems at scale. Operating in a highly digital environment, data sits at the centre of decision-making, giving the team the opportunity to test ideas quickly, measure outcomes, and create meaningful impact across the business.
As the company continues to invest in its Data & ML capabilities, they're looking for a Data Scientist to join a collaborative team where curiosity, analytical thinking and commercial impact are valued just as highly as technical expertise.
About the role:This is an opportunity to apply statistics, machine learning and advanced analytics to solve real business problems. You'll work closely with commercial teams to understand complex challenges, identify opportunities, and develop data-driven solutions that create measurable value.
The role has a particular focus on marketing and growth, but you'll be joining a wider Data Science function and working alongside experienced Data Scientists on a variety of business-critical initiatives.
This is a role for someone who enjoys asking the right questions, applying the appropriate analytical techniques, and taking ownership of problems from initial exploration through to models being deployed into production and delivering measurable impact.
What you'll do:Frame business challenges as data science problems and identify the most appropriate analytical approach.Develop statistical and machine learning models that improve decision making and business performance.Design and evaluate experiments, causal analyses and predictive models to generate actionable insights.Work closely with business stakeholders to understand priorities and translate data into commercial value.Partner with engineering teams to ensure models are successfully deployed, monitored and continue delivering value in production.Identify new opportunities where data science can improve efficiency and support business growth.
About you:We're looking for someone with a strong academic foundation who enjoys applying theory to real-world business challenges.
You'll likely have:3+ years' experience in a Data Science or advanced analytics role.A degree in Mathematics, Statistics or another highly quantitative discipline, with a Master's degree or above preferred.Strong Python skills for data analysis, statistical modelling and machine learning.Excellent understanding of statistical methods, modelling techniques and when to apply them appropriately.Experience building models that have been deployed into production and created measurable business value.Confidence translating ambiguous business questions into structured analytical solutions.Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.A proactive mindset and the ability to take ownership from problem definition through to business impact.
Experience working with marketing analytics, experimentation, attribution or customer behaviour would be beneficial, but the strongest candidates will be those with excellent data science fundamentals and a passion for solving business problems.
Why join?This is a business where data genuinely drives decisions. With a highly digital product and rich datasets, you'll be able to form hypotheses, test them quickly and see the impact of your work in real time.
You'll be joining a collaborative Data & ML team within an established fintech that combines the stability of a successful business with the agility and autonomy of a smaller organisation. Rather than working on isolated research projects or predefined tickets, you'll have the opportunity to shape solutions, influence decision-making and see your work translate into measurable commercial outcomes.
The company offers a flexible hybrid working model (typically two to three days a week in their central Stockholm office), modern tooling, excellent benefits and the opportunity to work alongside experienced Data Scientists in an environment that values continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.
If you're a Data Scientist who enjoys combining strong statistical thinking with practical problem solving - and wants to see your work make a tangible business impact - we'd love to hear from you.

Title: VOC Data & Insights Specialist
Description:
About The Role

We are looking for the VOC Data & Insights Specialist who thrives on turning raw data into actionable stories. In this role, you will be the bridge between our customer data systems and business decisions. You will be responsible for pulling data directly from APIs, querying a Data Warehouse as an advanced end-user, and building dynamic reports in Excel and Tableau.

A significant portion of this role focuses on Support Operations and Text Analytics. You will leverage Zendesk Explore to monitor support performance and use text analytics to extract meaningful customer sentiment and trends from unstructured data.

If you love data wrangling, have a knack for finding patterns in text, and enjoy building practical reports using both warehouse data and platform APIs, we want to hear from you.

You Will Be Responsible For


Data Extraction & Querying: Query data directly from our Data Warehouse to pull relevant operational datasets. Connect to and extract data from various platform APIs when direct warehouse integration isn't available.
Data Preparation: Clean, manipulate, and merge disparate datasets (from DWH, APIs, and manual uploads) to ensure accuracy and consistency before reporting.
CX & Support Analytics: Act as our internal expert for Zendesk Explore. Build, maintain, and optimize dashboards to track customer support KPIs, team productivity, and service bottlenecks.
Text & Sentiment Analytics: Analyze unstructured text data (customer tickets, feedback, chat logs) using text analytics techniques to identify emerging customer pain points, feature requests, and sentiment trends.
Report & Dashboard Creation: Design and maintain clear, user-friendly reports and dashboards in Tableau and Excel (utilizing advanced formulas, Power Query, and Pivot Tables) for cross-functional teams.


Our Successful Candidate Will Have The Following


DWH & API Familiarity: Strong experience as a DWH user (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) with the ability to write SQL queries to extract data. Experience working with APIs to pull data. SQL , Python.
Tool Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Excel (Power Query is a must) and hands-on experience building visualizations in Tableau.
Zendesk Explore: Direct, practical experience navigating and building custom reports within Zendesk Explore.
Text Analytics: Experience with text mining, sentiment analysis, or categorization of unstructured qualitative data.
Analytical Mindset: Strong attention to detail with the ability to spot trends and anomalies that others might miss.
Communication: Ability to explain data concepts and insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.


Who We Are

At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 18 offices worldwide.

Benefits


Hybrid work policy
4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle
Private health insurance
Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants
We offer an employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments.


JOIN US!

In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!

Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!

As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

Title: Data Scientist, Customer Solutions
Description:
Haluatko ratkaista ongelmia yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa?

Etsimme Data Scientistia, joka vie Terveystalon data- ja analytiikkaosaamisen suoraan asiakasrajapintaan. Tärkeintä roolissa onnistumisen kannalta on vahva tekninen osaaminen, ulospäinsuuntautunut ja utelias can do- asenne sekä aiempi työkokemus data scientistin tehtävistä. Kuulet asiakkaan haasteen ja rakennat jo samana päivänä prototyyppiä siitä, miten data voisi auttaa. Olet erityisen innostunut tekoälyn tuomista uusista mahdollisuuksista ja nautit ideoinnista yhdessä asiakkaiden sekä tiimisi kanssa.

Mikä on pelikenttäsi?

Terveystalo on Suomen suurin yksityinen terveyspalveluyritys ja Pohjoismaiden johtava työterveyden toimija. Meillä on poikkeuksellinen datamassa suomalaisesta terveydestä ja nyt etsimme data scientistia, joka osaa kääntää sen asiakkaillemme konkreettiseksi arvoksi. Haluamme olla aidosti asiakaslähtöinen terveyskumppani, mikä tarkoittaa, että palvelut suunnitellaan asiakkaan arjen, tarpeiden ja valintojen ympärille.

Työskentelet joko suoraan työterveysasiakkaidemme kanssa tai kuluttajadatan parissa. Tehtäväsi on tunnistaa asiakkaan keskeisimmät haasteet (esim. sairauspoissaolot, työkykyriskit, terveyden ylläpito, ennaltaehkäisy) ja rakentaa niiden ympärille skaalautuvia analytiikkatuotteita. Teet nopeita kokeiluja, protoilet lennosta, viet suunnittelemasi mallit itsenäisesti tuotantoon ja kommunikoit tulokset selkeästi.

Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Työskentelemme joustavasti Helsingissä Kampin toimistolla ja etänä.

Mitä tulet tekemään?


Tunnistat olennaisimmat työterveyden/ kuluttaja-asiakkaan haasteet ja datamahdollisuudet
Rakennat nopeasti toimivia datatuoteprototyyppejä
Hyödynnät AI-työkaluja ja LLM-pohjaisia ratkaisuja osana päivittäistä protoilua ja kehitystä
Muunnat asiakasoivallukset skaalautuviksi ratkaisuiksi
Toteutat analyysejä ja koneoppimismalleja itsenäisesti koko elinkaaren läpi: hausta käsittelyyn, oivalluksista tuotantoon
Kommunikoit tulokset selkeästi niin asiakkaalle, liiketoimintajohdolle kuin datakollegoillekin


Mitä odotamme sinulta?


Toiminnallisuus ennen kaikkea. Rakennat, kokeilet, iteroit. Lähdet nopeasti liikkeelle ja selvität asiat matkan varrella.
AI-natiivi työskentelytapa. Käytät LLM-työkaluja luontevasti niin ideointiin kuin koodaamiseen, päivittäin. Mittarisi ei ole AI:n käyttö sinänsä vaan sen tuoma lisäarvo.
Itseohjautuvuus ja uteliaisuus. Nautit alun epäselvyydestä ja siitä että saat kirkastaa päämäärän itse. Asiakkaan ongelma on aluksi usein sumea, mutta osaat muuntaa sen analyyttiseksi hypoteesiksi, pilkkoa tekniseksi kokonaisuudeksi ja viedä hankkeen maaliin itsenäisesti.
Konsultoiva ja myynnillinen ote. Tiedät, milloin asiakas tarvitsee visuaalisen oivalluksen ja milloin riittää yksi selkeä luku. Osaat selittää monimutkaiset asiat yksinkertaisesti ilman, että menetät tarkkuuden.
Halu toimia asiakasrajapinnassa ja kyky johtaa muutosta asiakkaan arjessa. Osaat kiteyttää monimutkaiset kokonaisuudet ymmärrettävään muotoon ja selittää vaikeat asiat yksinkertaisesti.

Vaikuttavan roolin. Tuloksesi näkyvät suoraan siinä, miten suomalaisia hoidetaan.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Job Number: R0245919

Data Scientist

The Opportunity:

As a data scientist, you’re excited at the prospect of unlocking the secrets held by a data set, and you’re fascinated by the possibilities presented by IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. In an increasingly connected world, massive amounts of structured and unstructured data open new opportunities. As a data scientist at Booz Allen, you can help turn these complex data sets into useful information to solve global challenges. Across private and public sectors—from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence—we need you to help find the answers in the data.

On our team, you’ll use your analytical skills and data science knowledge to create real-world impact. You’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs, and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. You’ll develop algorithms and systems and use the right combination of tools and frameworks to turn sets of disparate data points into objective answers to help clients make informed decisions. Ultimately, you’ll provide a deep understanding of the data, what it all means, and how it can be used.

Work with us as we use data science for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


3+ years of experience developing and maintaining machine learning, AI‑driven, or data‑centric applications
3+ years of experience designing, building, and operationalizing data and ML pipelines in production environments
3+ years of experience retrieving, parsing, and processing structured, semi‑structured, and unstructured data to support analytics, feature engineering, and model development
3+ years of experience integrating large language models (LLMs) into analytic and ML workflows, including prompt design, inference orchestration, and automated data processing
Experience collaborating within cross‑functional teams, such as data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and platform engineers, to deliver end‑to‑end DS or ML solutions
Secret clearance
Bachelor’s degree



Nice If You Have:


3+ years of experience with Python, SQL, or TypeScript in data or ML engineering contexts
3+ years of experience with UI/UX design
3+ years of experience working with geospatial datasets, spatial analytics, or geospatial ML workflows
3+ years of experience with distributed data and compute ecosystems, such as Spark, Databricks, Hadoop, Hive, AWS EMR, and Kafka, for large‑scale ML workloads
Experience operating in a Combatant Command or international mission‑focused environment and applying DS or ML methods to operational decision‑making
Experience using Palantir Foundry for data modeling, pipeline development, or operational analytics
TS/SCI clearance preferred



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $99,000.00 to $225,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.


Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.



Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Overview




At Lutron, we are transforming how people experience light through intelligent, connected lighting devices and systems. As a Data Scientist, you will apply data science, analytics, machine learning, and AI to help improve customer experiences, products, and business operations. You will work closely with senior data scientists, engineers, product managers, and business partners to turn data into actionable insights and deploy models into production.




Responsibilities




Contribute to end-to-end data science projects that improve product performance, customer experience, and operational efficiency, applying your strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Translate business questions into analytical approaches with clear metrics and success criteria,
Develop, test, and validate machine learning models and statistical analyses under guidance from senior team members
Partner with engineering and product teams to support deployment of models and analytics into production systems
Apply best practices in data cleaning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and documentation
Communicate findings, insights, and technical concepts clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Continuously learn and apply new data science and machine learning techniques relevant to Lutron’s products and business




Qualifications




Graduate degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field
Minimum, cumulative GPA of 3.00 for all degrees earned
4+ years of hands-on experience in data science, analytics, or machine learning
Proficiency in Python or R, with working knowledge of SQL
Familiarity with common machine learning techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, and time series analysis
Experience using ML libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar




Desired Qualifications




Experience deploying models into production environments
Exposure to cloud services from AWS, Azure, or similar providers
Experience working with IoT or sensor data
Familiarity with Agile development practices




Starting pay: $120,000 - $135,000 per year; Lutron's employee benefits include 401k match, health, dental, and life insurance, paid vacation (amount based on tenure with the company), flexible spending accounts, and tuition reimbursement programs. "

Title: Product Data Scientist
Description:
Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.

Ever wonder how much of a lift a new flavor gives us, or which flavor a specific machine should be pouring in a specific office at a specific moment? That's this role. We're looking for a Product Data Scientist to support both our Beverage and Software product teams — measuring the incremental impact of every new flavor we launch, and building the recommendation engine that decides what each machine should offer next. You'll also own analytics across our Bevi-proprietary digital experiences, including the UI and the Well, plus our other websites (get a quote, order more, technical support). You'll partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering on both teams, turning data into a clear point of view on what we build next. We're looking for someone who spots what needs to get built before being asked, and drives it to done rather than waiting for direction.
